title: Inquisitive Enchantment
description: A vanilla-friendly enchantment that rewards every battle with greater experience.
body:
## Knowledge is Power
Every battle teaches a lesson.

XP progression can feel really slow, especially when you're in the middle of "Should I make this farm?" or "Which tool should I enchant first? I only have limited exp". I feel you.

Let me introduce you to....

![Inquisitive](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4822e68f6585356ec2f4613347d81db9ff22a146.png)

Inquisitive is a vanilla-friendly enchantment that rewards players with additional experience from combat, making every encounter more meaningful without breaking Minecraft's natural progression.

Whether you're repairing treasured gear with Mending, preparing for your next enchantment, or simply enjoying survival, Inquisitive ensures that every victory contributes to your journey.

Designed to feel like a feature Mojang could have added, Inquisitive integrates seamlessly into vanilla gameplay with balanced progression and multiplayer compatibility.

## Features

✔ New enchantment: Inquisitive

✔ Earn more XP from defeated mobs

✔ Works naturally with Mending

✔ Multiplayer compatible

✔ Lightweight

✔ Vanilla balanced

## Compatibility

✔ Multiplayer

✔ Fabric

✔ Servers

✔ Client

✔ Fabric API

## How to obtain?

You can obtain the enchantment from villagers and enchanting table level 30, it's a rare enchantment. (only available from villagers in 1.21, only from level 5 Librarian in 26.2)

## FAQ
Q: Do you plan to add configuration?

A: Yes, it's important that you can also configure how powerful it should be.

Q: Is it balanced?

A: This mod is designed around vanilla progression.

Q: Do you plan to backport or keep this mod updated?

A: Absolutely!
